title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
summary:
arXiv:2610.11344v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Physics-based models connect scientific explanation with quantitative prediction. Constructing them requires selecting physical processes, defining states and governing equations, specifying couplings, and identifying parameters from experiments. Existing AI systems remain limited in making these model structure decisions autonomously. We introduce EvoSim, a self-evolving AI scientist for physical modeling.
